verdict.rationale: Clerk offers webhooks that fire on events like user creation/update, giving a basic event-trigger mechanism, but there's no evidence of a built-in rules engine, conditional logic, or automated actions beyond delivering the webhook payload — developers must build the 'action' side themselves outside Clerk. Missing for 10: native rules/automation engine, conditional trigger logic, built-in actions (not just event notifications), and any documentation of automation workflows beyond webhook delivery.
